formulas.title: QK + Softmax + SV
formulas.equation: MAC_QK+SV = B × H_q × Q × S_access × (d_qk + d_v)
formulas.notes: 此处只列两个矩阵乘法；softmax、访存和通信另计。prefill 的 causal/tile 调度不应直接用整个矩形当作精确有效 FLOPs。
formulas.variables: B=batch; S=context; Q=query tokens; L=layers; D=hidden; b=bytes/element

formulas.title: MLA decode：吸收后的维度
formulas.equation: d_QK = c_KV + d_RoPE; d_SV = c_KV; MAC/(B×H_q×Q×S_access) = 2c_KV + d_RoPE
formulas.notes: DSV3.x c_KV=512、RoPE=64：QK=576，SV=512，共1088。不能重复加64，也不能把decode SV错用为128。维度只在硬件边界对齐一次。
formulas.variables: B=batch; S=context; Q=query tokens; L=layers; D=hidden; b=bytes/element

formulas.title: MLA prefill：展开后的维度
formulas.equation: d_QK = d_nope + d_RoPE; d_SV = d_v
formulas.notes: DSV3.x prefill 的数学维度192/128与decode吸收维度576/512不同；不能用单个hidden替代两个阶段。
formulas.variables: B=batch; S=context; Q=query tokens; L=layers; D=hidden; b=bytes/element

formulas.equation: S_access = min(S, k); main KV gather ≈ B × L × S_access × (c_KV + d_RoPE) × b
formulas.notes: 这里确实只 gather top-k 个主 KV。indexer仍需扫描全量轻量索引键；缓存驻留和PD移交不随top-k同比缩小。实际分页、重复读、量化scale和cache复用由kernel决定。

formulas.title: DSA 全 heads 打分后统一 top-k
formulas.equation: score[b,q,s] = scale_K[s] × Σ_h weight[b,q,h] × ReLU(Q[b,q,h]·K[b,s]); MAC=BQSHd
formulas.notes: V3.2 每 rank 使用完整 index_n_heads，不按 TP 除。点积、ReLU、加权与 head 归约融合，仅写 B×Q×S 个 FP32 分数，再每 query 一次 top-k。CSA则按TP分heads并先all-reduce统一分数。参考索引历史在CP间复制；主KV可独立CP分片。

formulas.title: 参考辅助投影的独立精度策略
formulas.equation: FP8 operands → FP32 accumulation → BF16 output; weight/input/output/cache precision resolve independently
formulas.notes: 默认official_mixed_v1：官方FP8配置的DSA Q/K、V4 index-query和MTP融合投影采用FP8 E4M3；显式bf16_deployment_v1或reference_dtype=bf16保留BF16部署。DSA物理scale为FP32，V4为E8M0。DSA scoring-weight投影仍为FP32，V4对应投影为BF16；compressor、norm归约与mHC声明的FP32计算/参数保持独立。已知DeepSeek无dtype时默认FP8，未声明精度的通用旧模型回退BF16；全局专家FP4不意味着辅助投影FP4。V4 QAT缓存仍物理存储BF16。
formulas.variables: B=batch; S=context; Q=query tokens; L=layers; D=hidden; b=bytes/element

formulas.title: FP8 权重的二维分块与 TP 驻留
formulas.equation: W_rank = C_in_local × C_out_local + ceil(C_in_local/128) × ceil(C_out_local/128) × s_w
formulas.notes: 先按TP所有权取本rank逻辑矩阵，再独立对两个轴向上取整，尾块仍占完整scale；不能用ceil(元素总数/16384)替代二维块数。DSA索引Q/K与MTP融合权重复制；V4 index-query按列分片。BF16部署每权重2字节且没有FP8 scale。
formulas.variables: C_in_local/C_out_local：本rank输入/输出通道；列分片C_out_local=ceil(C_out/TP)，行分片C_in_local=ceil(C_in/TP)，复制保持原形状；s_w=4（DSA FP32）或1（V4 E8M0）bytes。

formulas.title: 完整 KV/gate Compressor
formulas.equation: MAC_proj=2BQD(c·d); blocks=floor((S+Q)/r)−floor(S/r); C=QuantDequant(RoPE(RMSNorm(Σ_t softmax_t(gate+APE)·KV)))
formulas.notes: KV和gate为独立FP32投影，所有新token均执行；完整块才池化。r=4时c=2，含双窗口重叠和状态滚动；prefill仅写最终保留状态。index compressor额外Hadamard。官方量化为QAT模拟，缓存实际BF16，不能按packed FP4减少容量。
formulas.variables: B=batch; S=context; Q=query tokens; L=layers; D=hidden; b=bytes/element

def _mhc(model, source):
    config = _config(model)
    streams = max(int(source.get("mhc_streams") or config.get("hc_mult") or 1), 1)
    iters = int(config.get("hc_sinkhorn_iters", 20))
    if iters < 1:
        raise ValueError("hc_sinkhorn_iters must be positive")
    hidden = int(model["hidden"])
    mixed = streams * streams + 2 * streams
    root = str(source["NN name"])
    base = dict(source, mhc_streams=streams, sinkhorn_iters=iters,
                gpu_config_tuning="ffn_replicated" if source.get("component") == "mhc_ffn" else "attention_replicated")

            semantics=[_semantic("stream_residual_mix", ["B", "T", streams, hidden],

def cache_memory(config, *, seq_len, policy='packed'):
    c = text_config(config)
    if policy not in {'packed', 'reference'} or seq_len < 0:
        raise ValueError('Invalid cache policy or sequence length')
    d, di = c['head_dim'], c['index_head_dim']

    main = d/2 + math.ceil(d/16) if policy == 'packed' else d*2
    index = di/2 + math.ceil(di/32) if policy == 'packed' else di*2
    local = d + math.ceil(d/32) if policy == 'packed' else d*2

        compressor_state_bytes=compressor_bytes, runtime_bytes=global_bytes+window_bytes+compressor_bytes,

def _cycle_counts(remaining, cap, probabilities):

def transfer_cost(plan, *, layers, weight_passes=1):
    """Read spilled weights/cache each pass; read/write activation spill per layer.

All experts are streamed conservatively, without assuming an active-expert cache.
Cache traffic counts a full read and write (an upper proxy). Activation reserve
already covers the whole batch/query window, so its traffic is not multiplied
again by weight passes. No overlap or unverified DRAM transaction latency is used.
"""

        raise ValueError('Positive integer layers and passes required')
    spill = plan['external_components']
    traffic = dict(weights=spill['weights']*weight_passes,

def cache_memory(config, *, seq_len, policy='packed'):
    c = text_config(config)
    if policy not in {'packed', 'reference'} or seq_len < 0:
        raise ValueError('Invalid cache policy or sequence length')
    d, di = c['head_dim'], c['index_head_dim']
    # Main NVFP4: E2M1 + 1 E4M3/16. Index MXFP4: E2M1 + 1 E8M0/32.
    main = d/2 + math.ceil(d/16) if policy == 'packed' else d*2
    index = di/2 + math.ceil(di/32) if policy == 'packed' else di*2
    local = d + math.ceil(d/32) if policy == 'packed' else d*2
    owners = [x for x in layer_schedule(config) if x['mode'] == 'full']
    global_bytes = sum((seq_len//x['compress_ratio'])*(main+index) for x in owners)
    window_bytes = c['num_hidden_layers'] * min(seq_len, c['sliding_window']) * local
    compressor_bytes = sum(2*x['compress_ratio']*d*4 for x in owners if x['compress_ratio'] > 1)
    ed = c['engram_head_dim']
    engram_bytes = sum(c['engram_num_embeddings']) * (ed + math.ceil(ed/32))
    return dict(global_bytes=global_bytes, window_bytes=window_bytes,
        compressor_state_bytes=compressor_bytes, runtime_bytes=global_bytes+window_bytes+compressor_bytes,
        engram_table_bytes=engram_bytes, global_bytes_per_token=sum((main+index)/x['compress_ratio'] for x in owners))

    """Read spilled weights/cache each pass; read/write activation spill per layer.
